title: 733. Number of Atoms

examples.explanation: Two H and one O; the count 1 is hidden.
Doubling (OH) yields H2, Mg and O2 in sorted order.

hints: Scan with a stack of count maps: push a fresh map on '(' and pop on ')', multiplying the popped counts before merging.
Parse element names as one uppercase letter plus following lowercase letters, then read the optional digits as the multiplier.
Sort the final keys alphabetically and skip the digit 1 when building the answer.
